create_deterministic_distribution: create a Deterministic distribution with loc, atol, and rtol parameters for scalar values
test_deterministic_log_prob: test the Deterministic distribution log_prob method with inputs at the loc value
test_deterministic_sample: test sampling from a Deterministic distribution with various sample shapes and dtypes
test_deterministic_kl_divergence: test KL divergence between two Deterministic distributions in distrax and TFP modes
test_deterministic_slicing: test slicing a Deterministic distribution with single elements, ranges, and ellipsis indices
